description.value: Alouette Cabin is a fee-based wilderness hut operated by BC Parks within Golden Ears Provincial Park, one of BC's largest and most popular parks located roughly an hour east of Vancouver. The cabin offers basic backcountry shelter with a fireplace and toilets in the park's rugged, mountainous interior. Cyclists considering a stay should note that Golden Ears' backcountry terrain is described by BC Parks as extremely rugged, and no cell service is available in most areas of the park.
